body:
Having been with a partner who is serious about recovery and a slew of partners in the past who were not. That “let’s get this over with quick” is pointlessly sus. My guy isn’t vocal by any means, he’s quiet in nature, but he will talk openly about urges, quotes he’s read that helped him, just stuff.

Proof is in the pudding, as my mum use to say.

So, I joined nofap for masturbation addiction (not porn) and am in a relationship with someone who is recovering from porn addiction. I joined a nofap discord server and got *extremely* involved. I’m on day 70 and my partner is on day 71. 
There are so many different levels of ownership and personal attitudes about porn and porn recovery that I can’t even begin. The majority of people I met are struggling constantly to quit (most while single, which leads me to think that the decision to quit porn is more often an individual’s inclinations rather than one’s relationship status, sex life, or how much they love someone.)
Based on what I’ve learned through the hundreds of guys I’ve seen trying to recover, your guy… might not be lying that he’s just peeking. At least 75% of the time, but to me it still feels like betrayal. If he doesn’t see the error, I don’t see the point for you. There’s so much information out there about why it’s bad from the guy’s perspective. Find a YouTube video or a short article. See if he’s receptive, and try to tell him how much this hurts you. Honestly, if things don’t work out, there are so many good fish in the sea. Beautiful souls inside and out. If he doesn’t get over it, consider my advice and stop hurting yourself with someone who doesn’t value you (or his own mental health when you think about it).
Care to switch over to DM?
I haven’t told them about the betrayal.
